issues.description: Field mismatch: The attribute Person.firstName has conflicting types across artifacts. In the template repository (and in the unit tests) Person.firstName is declared and used as a String (e.g., person.setFirstName("Max")). In the solution repository the field is declared as an int (private int firstName;) while the getter and setter in the same solution class have String signatures (public String getFirstName(), public void setFirstName(String)). This internal contradiction in the solution causes a compilation error and prevents students from building or running the project and confuses them about the intended type for firstName.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the type of Person.firstName consistent across all artifacts. Change the field declaration in the solution repository to use String (private String firstName;) and ensure the getter and setter signatures/implementations use String. This aligns the solution with the template and tests and resolves the compilation error.
